The tree is a function of the input, the design, the active breakpoints, the resolved images and the request id alone: the Elementor release, the theme and the page frame change the digest or builder_facts and never the tree. "library_alt" is the alt text each image has in the media library; the precheck refuses a logo or an image whose alt text is another, and no tree holds it.
